title: A footprint score fixed before the test does not predict how much each new monitor is fooled
subtitle: Each dot is one new monitor the model never saw in training, in 2 training runs. Dots on the dashed line would mean the score predicts the fooled share.
x: overlap score with the training probe, computed before any behaviour test
y: fooled share of the flattery drop
key_line: prediction fixed before the test (fooled share = overlap score)
note: Fooled share 100% = the model hides its flattery from this monitor as well as from the training probe; 0% = this monitor catches all the model's normal flattery. Bars: 95% intervals over 200 test prompts.
r2_gloss: R²: how close the dots sit to the dashed line (1 = on it; we needed 0.70)
bitexact: bit-exact monitors: 0% fooled in both runs
key_ring: ring: training probe, seen-before or bit-exact monitor
